rules.name: Reduced categories
rules.conditions: groceries, utilities, education, fuel, rent, transit, telecom and similar earn the reduced rate; government capped/low

insurance.text: Visa travel medical and accident cover up to USD 500,000

welcome_offer.text: 25,000 Skywards Miles for activation and first retail purchase within 30 days of issue

cards.notes: Miles are quoted per USD 1 by the bank; converted to per AED at 3.6725. International (non-AED, non-EEA) spend earns a higher rate that the engine cannot express: 1.5 miles/USD (0.41/AED) international, 0.6 in EEA.. point_value_aed 0.03 is a conservative estimate of a Skywards/Etihad mile. Profit rate 3.75%/month, 55-day grace. ADIB lists reduced rates for government, groceries, utilities, education, fuel, real estate, transit/Salik, charity. Aggregator shows AED 5,000 min salary, unusually low vs fee; verify.
